name: Set up Opportunity List View
purpose: Opportunity list setup: when the list shows every record, finds active opportunities and sorts them by status and name; then asks the controller for the active-opportunity status totals, compiles the SalesOppChart widget in karbon_charts and loads it into the SalesOppChartWebViewer web viewer, with error dialogs if the widget or web viewer fail.
reads:
Opportunity::ActiveInd#59 (find criterion step 15; value 1)
Opportunity::StatusCached#50 (sort key step 18, ascending)
Opportunity::Name#69 (sort key step 18, ascending)
calls:
karbon_kontroller.fmp12/scripts/682 "Get Active Opportunities Status Value" (step 35; Perform Script; data source karbon_kontroller.fmp12)
karbon_charts.fmp12/scripts/1252 "Compile Widget { name; data }" (step 41; Perform Script; data source karbon_charts.fmp12)
external: Set Web Viewer (step 49; loads the compiled widget URL into SalesOppChartWebViewer)
open_question: The initial find runs only when found count equals total record count. Both web viewer errors show the same message. Example-data Insert Text steps are disabled. Chart totals come from kontroller script 682, not read here.
